title: Guardian Consent Collection Workflow
description: Trace where 'collection begins' sits relative to 'consent obtained' -- and why the order is not negotiable.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given the steps of a club's consent process, the learner sequences them correctly and identifies which step must precede any data collection.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin sequence with a consent gate and two converging outcomes
pedagogical.assessment: Ask what the club may record for a student whose guardian declined.
